subject: SOC2 & DPA artifacts for cloud listing: action items & timeline
messages:
From: Jessica Su <jessica.su@amazon.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: ApexCloud Marketplace <marketplace-onboarding@apexcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Documentation needed for AWS listing - SOC2 / DPA / Pen test

Hi Neha / Lauren,

Thanks for progressing the AWS Marketplace listing with ApexCloud. Before we can enable co-sell and the public listing we need the following security artifacts uploaded to Seller Central or shared via a secure link:

- SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 summary of controls (if full report is restricted)
- Evidence of a recent third-party penetration test or a pen-test attestation letter (within last 12 months)
- Executed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or a redline + expected sign date
- Contact for security incident escalation and SOC point of contact

Target ETA: May 28, 2026. If you can’t meet that, please propose an alternate timeline.

Upload link: https://sellercentral.marketplace.amazon.com/listing/Redwood-12345 (permissions: marketplace-onboarding@apexcloud.com)

If there are any controls gaps we can note them on the listing but need the artifacts for review. Let me know if you need a secure upload method (we can provision an S3 pre-signed link).

Best,
Jessica
Partner Programs Manager, AWS Marketplace

--
Jessica Su
Amazon Web Services
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Documentation needed for AWS listing - SOC2 / DPA / Pen test

Forwarding Jessica's ask — high priority for the AWS listing. Assigning owners and immediate asks below.

TL;DR
- Deadline to get artifacts into Seller Central: 2026-05-28
- Lauren: ownership of upload & portal confirmation with ApexCloud
- Karthik: confirm SOC2 summary & final signed DPA attached or status update by EOD 5/23
- Sergio: coordinate with Acme Security for pen-test attestation letter, copy to AWS if needed

Action items (please reply inline with status):
1) SOC2: we have a summary doc but not the full Type II. Karthik, can you attach the summary and list any significant exclusions?
2) DPA: Legal shared v3 last week — need signed copy. If not signed, share redline + expected sign date.
3) Pen-test: we did a pen-test in Jan 2026, but I don’t think we have a formal attestation letter; Sergio, please request the letter and ask Acme to include scope & date.
4) Upload: Lauren, once items are gathered, upload to the Seller Central link and confirm with Jessica.

Attachments: (placeholders) Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf, Redwood_DPA_v3_draft.pdf

Quote from original for context:
> From: Jessica Su <jessica.su@amazon.com>
> Before we can enable co-sell and the public listing we need the following security artifacts uploaded to Seller Central or shared via a secure link:
> - SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 summary of controls
> - Evidence of a recent third-party penetration test or a pen-test attestation letter
> - Executed Data Processing Addendum (DPA)

Thanks team — suggest short sync if any blockers.

-Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Documentation needed for AWS listing - SOC2 / DPA / Pen test

Neha — quick status update: attaching SOC2 summary and the signed DPA we received from Acme Legal this morning.

Status details:
- SOC2: Attached \"Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf\" — this is a one-page controls summary we can share publicly; full Type II report is restricted but available under NDA. Controls cover availability, confidentiality, and processing integrity for production services. No material exceptions for the period Jan–Dec 2025.
- DPA: Attached \"Redwood_DPA_v3_signed.pdf\" — legal confirms this is the version approved for marketplace activities.
- Notes on pen-test: the January 2026 pen-test covered our core inference API and web portal. The report includes sensitive findings; Acme can provide a redacted pen-test letter (attestation) suitable for public sharing. Sergio, please confirm timeline with Acme for the attestation letter.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf; Redwood_DPA_v3_signed.pdf

Karthik Iyer
Director, Security and Compliance (Redwood Inference)
From: Acme Security <ops@acme-sec.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Pen-test attestation letter for Redwood — Jan 2026 scan (attached)

Sergio / Neha,

Attached is the pen-test attestation letter for Redwood's January 2026 external assessment (file: pen-test-letter-Acme-2026.pdf). The letter confirms the engagement scope, testing dates (2026-01-10 to 2026-01-18), and that no critical unauthenticated remote code-execution findings remain open as of the final remediation verification.

Notes: the full report contains sensitive technical details; we’ve redacted exploit PoCs and client-specific logs from the public attestation. If AWS requires additional evidence under an NDA, we can provision the full report to their security review team.

Regards,
Maya Ramesh
Engagement Lead, Acme Security
ops@acme-sec.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Documentation needed for AWS listing - SOC2 / DPA / Pen test — artifacts uploaded

Hi Jessica,

Per your request, we uploaded the following artifacts to the Seller Central listing this afternoon:
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (public summary)
- Redwood_DPA_v3_signed.pdf (executed DPA)
- pen-test-letter-Acme-2026.pdf (attestation, redacted)

Upload link: https://sellercentral.marketplace.amazon.com/listing/Redwood-12345 (files in Documents > Security)

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you need the full SOC2 Type II under NDA or the unredacted pen-test report. If AWS requires the full reports, Karthik can coordinate an NDA and secure transfer.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Lauren — please follow up with ApexCloud to confirm co-sell enablement timeline once Jessica confirms.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
